reason: The plugin is primarily an external-service integration utility for DSH that displays API account balances for configured LLM providers directly under the chat input, with refresh behavior and recharge-link actions. It combines a host service that queries provider endpoints and a web client UI panel that polls and presents those balances, so its user-facing purpose is to surface provider billing status inside the conversation interface.

summaries.zh: 该插件会在 DSH 聊天输入区下方显示已配置 LLM 提供商的余额状态，并在可用时提供充值页跳转入口。
summaries.en: This plugin shows configured LLM provider balance status under the DSH chat input area and provides links to open recharge pages when supported.

reasons.code: README states the plugin reads configured LLM providers from DSH and resolves API keys via host credentials, then calls provider balance APIs for those providers.
README describes a host endpoint GET /llm-balance and a web client that polls it and renders a provider balance strip in the chat composer footer.
package.json exposes lib/index.js and lib/client.js with dsh web client injection plus bundle patch, indicating host-side and browser-side integration.
